description: Fetch a web page URL and convert it to clean Markdown optimized for LLM context. Preserves headings, code blocks (with language hints), links, and tables; keeps the main content and drops navigation, headers, footers, and sidebars. It fetches without cookies and runs no page scripts, so a page behind a sign-in or one rendered only by JavaScript comes back as its login page or with no content; read those through a browser tool instead. It requests only the URL given, as a browser opens a page, so docs sites return the page itself, not a Markdown copy of it; a URL that names a Markdown or text file (a raw GitHub README.md, an llms.txt) comes back as written. Discovers tab groups statically and emits each panel as a `### Tab: {label}` section instead of concatenating (prevents Python+TypeScript examples merging into one broken block). Zero external API calls — parses locally via linkedom.

include_frontmatter.description: Prepend a YAML frontmatter block with title, source URL, capture timestamp, language, description, and canonical URL.

include_images.description: Include image references (![alt](src)) in the output.

timeout_ms.description: Abort the fetch after N milliseconds. Range: 1000-60000.

url.description: Absolute HTTP or HTTPS URL of the web page to convert. Blocks private ranges, loopback, and cloud metadata endpoints.

name: page_to_markdown
title: Convert Page to Markdown
